propositions: The audit page renderer at page.py:329 currently only accepts kind == "operator-attested" when determining if a criterion is lacking; it must be widened to also accept kind == "non-codebase"
827 existing COMPLETION_VERDICT events in the live store carry kind: "operator-attested" which are immutable; both old and new kind values must be accepted before S5 changes the verifier output
The lacking field computation is the only site in the codebase comparing criterion kind values; page.py:329 is the sole location requiring modification
Rendering a PASS verdict with kind: "operator-attested" and met: false must produce lacking: true
Rendering a PASS verdict with kind: "non-codebase" and met: false must produce lacking: true
Criteria with kind: "codebase-verifiable" must remain unaffected regardless of met value
